name: Blacksmithing
desc: Higher smithing skill allows you to learn higher level smithing plans.  Blacksmithing plans can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.

ranks.name: Apprentice
ranks.desc: Allows a Blacksmith to make basic weapons and armor up to a maximum potential skill of 75. Requires stone and metal found with the mining skill.

ranks.name: Journeyman
ranks.desc: Allows a Blacksmith to make well-crafted weapons and armor up to a maximum potential skill of 150.

ranks.name: Expert
ranks.desc: Allows a Blacksmith to make masterful weapons and armor up to a maximum potential skill of 225.

ranks.name: Artisan
ranks.desc: Allows a Blacksmith to make weapons and armor up to a maximum potential skill of 300.

specs.name: Armorsmith
specs.desc: Allows a blacksmith to make special armors that are unavailable to the typical artisan blacksmith.

specs.name: Weaponsmith
specs.desc: Allows a blacksmith to make special weapons that are unavailable to the typical artisan blacksmith.

specs.name: Master Swordsmith
specs.desc: Allows a blacksmith to make special Swords that are unavailable to the typical artisan weaponsmith.

specs.name: Master Hammersmith
specs.desc: Allows a blacksmith to make special maces and hammers that are unavailable to the typical artisan weaponsmith.

specs.name: Master Axesmith
specs.desc: Allows a blacksmith to make special axes that are unavailable to the typical artisan weaponsmith.
